title: fix(kimi): don't yank the live thinking box before JSONL catches up
context:
A thinking-only step (kimi reasons, then calls a tool with no interim
text) never set visibleContentAdded, so the turn's 'result' event hit the
lingerMs:0 fallback path in handleSpawnEvents and clearStreamingBubble ran
immediately -- wiping the streamed thinking box before the JSONL re-render
(the primary hand-off, per its own comment) had a chance to replace it
with the persisted version. Looked like the thoughts just vanished. The
backend already persists the full thinking text (server.py
_acp
